title: Vehicle Repair Work Order Form
subtitle: General Vehicle Repair: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Vehicle Repair Work Order Form covers vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision. The service advisor records General Vehicle Repair authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Vehicle Repair Work Order Form keeps General Vehicle Repair exceptions visible until the service advisor handoff.
use_case: Use Vehicle Repair Work Order Form at repair facility, service bay, test area, and customer handoff point. Document vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision identity before General Vehicle Repair begins. Compare vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision findings with stated General Vehicle Repair criteria; route unresolved General Vehicle Repair issues to qualified automotive repair reviewer. For Vehicle Repair Work Order Form, confirm requirements for General Vehicle Repair. Ask qualified automotive repair reviewer to review General Vehicle Repair conditions beyond the service advisor's role.
